Sam (AE): Prospect risk asked for a firm statement: do customer keys ever leave their control for Dedicated/Private? Need RFP-safe language + attestation.
Maya (Security): Short answer: no. When BYOK is configured, Redwood only stores wrapped/encrypted key material. KEKs remain in the customer's KMS/HSM and Redwood cannot export unwrapped key material. We can provide HSM/CloudHSM attestation and FIPS certs under NDA.
Jorge (Infra): Crypto notes: AES-256-GCM at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, envelope encryption with DEKs encrypted by customer CMK. DEKs are short-lived in secure process memory; KEKs never written to disk in plaintext.
Eve (Customer Sec): Rotation and automation: will you rotate CMKs or help with rewraps? Need recommended cadence.
Maya (Security): Recommended: follow customer policy (common: CMK rotate 90 days, up to 1yr). DEKs rotated per workload (per-session or per-request). We do not silently rotate customer-managed CMKs; we can run coordinated rewrap/alias-swap workflows with customers for automated rollover.
Sam (AE): ok. Please add a one-paragraph RFP statement and a one-page checklist. Also include CAIQ/SIG extracts and any redacted HSM attestations.
Maya (Security): will upload approved paragraph, checklist, CAIQ v3, SIG-Lite, and redacted attestation bundle to secure storage in ~15m.
upload-bot: uploaded s3://redwood-sec/pm-5873/risk-pack.zip
Eve (Customer Sec): thanks, that should cover the vendor risk review.
Sam (AE): thanks team :thumbsup:
